categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the network information security sector, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of network security products and services. Key segments include application security, cloud security, data security, IoT security, smart city security, industrial internet security, and commercial cryptography. It also provides managed security services (MSS), security consulting, emergency response, and security talent training.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies encompass AI-driven security models, large-scale security domain-specific AI models (HengNao), deep learning, big data analytics, cloud-native architectures, privacy computing, zero-trust security frameworks, and advanced threat detection including sandboxing and vulnerability prioritization. Production involves assembling hardware integrated with proprietary software, with order-driven and forecast-based manufacturing processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves government agencies, telecommunications operators, financial institutions, energy, transportation, healthcare, education, and large enterprises. It also supports major national and international events with cybersecurity services. The markets are primarily domestic Chinese sectors with expanding presence in cloud platforms and digital infrastructure.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are mainly concentrated in China, with headquarters in Hangzhou and multiple subsidiaries across major Chinese cities including Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Chengdu, and others. The company also has international subsidiaries and investments, including in Singapore. Its products are deployed on major domestic cloud platforms and some international cloud providers.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream of the cybersecurity supply chain, focusing on product development, integration, and service delivery. It procures hardware components and third-party software, assembles and integrates them with proprietary software, and delivers comprehensive security solutions and managed services to end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include AI integration across security products, development of AI security models and platforms, expansion of data security and privacy computing capabilities, enhancement of MSS services with AI-driven operations, and growth in commercial cryptography. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on AI+security, cloud security, data infrastructure, and IoT security, while actively participating in national standards development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through product sales (network security hardware and software), subscription-based managed security services (MSS), SaaS offerings, licensing, and professional security consulting services. The company also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Deepin Technology, Venustech, NSFOCUS, and Qi An Xin. The company holds a leading position in several segments such as data security, MSS, and cloud security in China, with top rankings in market share reports by IDC and Gartner. It is recognized as a leading innovator in AI-driven cybersecurity solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 2.04 billion, a slight decline from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 198 million, showing improvement from prior losses. R&D investment accounted for over 24% of revenue. The company has a workforce of over 3,600 employees, including nearly 1,000 in R&D, and maintains a strong patent portfolio with over 1,900 intellectual property rights.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes AI-driven intelligent security solutions, integrating large-scale domain-specific AI models to enhance threat detection, risk assessment, and automated response. Its comprehensive product ecosystem covers full lifecycle network security with strong capabilities in data classification, privacy computing, and cloud-native security. The company’s ability to provide integrated, intelligent, and customizable security solutions, combined with extensive experience in securing major national events, differentiates it in the market.
